name: hypertts-mcp-bridge
description: Generate audio for an Anki note by triggering a HyperTTS preset.
long_description: Exposes one narrow HyperTTS capability to an MCP client: "generate audio for note N using preset P", writing the [sound:...] tag into whatever field that preset targets - the same thing HyperTTS's own "Apply To Notes" button does. Requires Anki running with the HyperTTS add-on and the companion "HyperTTS MCP Bridge" Anki add-on (which serves a localhost HTTP bridge this server calls).

tools.name: list_hypertts_presets
tools.description: List the HyperTTS presets configured in the user's Anki, with id and name.

tools.name: generate_hypertts_audio
tools.description: Generate audio for a single Anki note using a HyperTTS preset.

bridge_url.title: Bridge URL
bridge_url.description: Address the Anki add-on's HTTP bridge listens on. Change only if you changed "host"/"port" in the Anki add-on's config.

api_key.title: Bridge API key
api_key.description: Only needed if you set "api_key" in the Anki add-on's config. Leave blank otherwise.
